change: Preserve a joined Ready private owner with no active proposal after pre-mutation refusal. Keep callback failure/rebuild and authoritative log/image gates unchanged.

candidate.label: candidate
candidate.method: Candidate-first frozen runtime comparison: preserved clean private workspace after admission refusal and bounded admission counters versus integrated 86297e7. Fresh persistent host node volumes through Colima virtiofs and external RustFS on the 224-GiB VM disk. Cold benchmark VM restart per cohort. Three nodes, 1 vCPU and 3 GiB each, 500 leaders and 1000 followers each, 1500 groups/3 voters, four SQL workers with 16 slots each (64 total), four archive retained-cut slots. Two 180-second windows at 24 writers. Same load AST. Quorum acknowledgements, exact 4500 replica values and 1500 archive positions; timed mutations never retry. Shared-host activity recorded; existing cumulative metrics are sampled outside each timed load process; this task performs no builds or profiling during timing. Compare sustained throughput and p99 without converting reconciliation into a timed pass.

control_preflight.basis: Four times the candidate observed consumption (321714) plus 200000 spare; all data retained; no workload or runtime limit changes.

method_limits: Sequential candidate-first runs on a shared host; throughput alone is not causal attribution.
Success latency excludes error responses. Both zero errors and p99 below 500 ms are required in every window.
Metrics bracket timed load processes and include small launch/exit intervals. Histograms give bucket bounds.
Admission counters count decisions including waiter rechecks and duplicate requests, not HTTP outcomes. Missing counters in control are unavailable, not zero.
Final archive coverage is separate from steady-state lag. Postfailure reconciliation never qualifies a failed timed window.
